remarks: Nestled on one of Rowayton's most desirable streets, 20 Indian Spring Rd stands on 0.8 acres, exuding charm and sophistication. This impeccably maintained home, built in 1940, blends old-world elegance with modern amenities. Inside, discover a stunningly renovated kitchen by nuKitchen, all-new bathrooms and updated mudroom, offering a turnkey experience in the heart of Rowayton. The main level features an inviting entry with a powder room, a spacious living room with 1 of the home's 3 fireplaces, a cozy den, and an impressive dining room that flows from the updated kitchen. A screened sun-porch offers views of the flagstone patio and lush backyard. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom includes a fireplace, complemented by two additional bedrooms. The lower level boasts a 4th en-suite bedroom, expansive family space, and a mudroom leading to a two-car garage. The vast backyard is ideal for outdoor entertaining. Just minutes from Rowayton's vibrant amenities, this home marries elegance with modern living. Additional square footage on the lower level.
